q_users.sql: LOOKUP ON item WHERE item.type == "beauty" YIELD id(vertex) AS id | GO 1 STEP FROM $-.id OVER buy REVERSELY WHERE buy.ts > 1753660800 YIELD DISTINCT buy._dst AS user

q_sales.sql: LOOKUP ON item WHERE item.type == "beauty" YIELD id(vertex) AS id | GO 1 STEP FROM $-.id OVER buy REVERSELY WHERE buy.ts > 1753660800 YIELD buy._dst AS uid, buy.amount AS amt | GROUP BY $-.uid YIELD $-.uid AS uid, sum($-.amt) AS sales | ORDER BY $-.sales DESC | LIMIT 100

q_count.sql: LOOKUP ON item WHERE item.type == "beauty" YIELD id(vertex) AS id | GO 1 STEP FROM $-.id OVER buy REVERSELY WHERE buy.ts > 1753660800 YIELD buy._dst AS uid, buy.amount AS amt | GROUP BY $-.uid YIELD $-.uid AS uid, count($-.amt) AS n

q_by_amount.sql: LOOKUP ON item WHERE item.type == "beauty" YIELD id(vertex) AS id | GO 1 STEP FROM $-.id OVER buy REVERSELY WHERE buy.ts > 1753660800 YIELD buy.amount AS amt | GROUP BY $-.amt YIELD $-.amt AS amt, count(*) AS n
